security_audit.summary: All 77 static alerts are false positives caused by RL environment names, Markdown formatting, ordinary assertions, documentation links, and expected checkpoint setup. One medium-risk credential issue remains because a Neptune token is accepted on the command line and can enter WandB configuration through vars(args). No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The Neptune token is accepted through a command-line argument.
remediation.suggestion: Read the token from a secret manager or protected environment variable so it does not enter shell history or process listings.

remediation.issue: WandB receives every parsed argument, including neptune_token, through vars(args).
remediation.suggestion: Build an allowlist of non-secret configuration fields and redact credentials before initializing any external logger.

content.user_title: Build Faster Reinforcement Learning with PufferLib
content.value_statement: Reinforcement learning projects often lose time on environment integration, policy design, and slow simulation. This skill provides focused PufferLib templates and optimization guidance.
actual_capabilities: Creates PuffeRL PPO training plans from the included command-line and Python templates.
Designs single-agent and multi-agent PufferEnv structures with observation, action, reward, and termination logic.
Explains integration patterns for Gymnasium, PettingZoo, Atari, Procgen, Minigrid, and other supported environments.
Develops PyTorch MLP, CNN, LSTM, continuous-action, and multi-agent policy architectures.
Tunes environment counts, worker counts, batching, shared memory, and asynchronous vectorization for higher throughput.
Configures checkpointing and optional Weights & Biases or Neptune experiment logging.
limitations: The skill does not execute or benchmark generated training setups.
Templates contain placeholders and may require changes for the installed PufferLib version.
External loggers transmit experiment data and require careful credential handling.
Distributed and GPU workflows depend on local hardware, drivers, and cluster configuration.

use_cases.title: Prototype benchmark experiments
use_cases.description: Plan PPO experiments across benchmark environments and compare vectorization settings before running full studies.

use_cases.title: Create custom environments
use_cases.description: Structure custom single-agent or multi-agent tasks with compatible spaces, lifecycle methods, and validation checks.

use_cases.title: Optimize training pipelines
use_cases.description: Adapt policies, checkpointing, logging, and distributed settings for an existing reinforcement learning pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic training setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal PufferLib PPO plan for [environment]. Use [CPU or GPU] and list every training template field I must change.

prompt_templates.title: Design a custom environment
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a PufferEnv for [task]. Define observations, actions, rewards, termination, reset behavior, and tests using the included environment template.
prompt_templates.scenario: Implementing a new reinforcement learning task.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a policy architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a [MLP, CNN, or LSTM] policy plan for [environment]. Explain tensor shapes, initialization, actor and critic outputs, and validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Matching a policy to an environment.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose vectorization performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose low throughput for [configuration]. Compare serial, multiprocessing, and asynchronous vectorization, then recommend measured changes for workers, environments, and batches.

output_examples.input: Plan a CPU training run for CartPole with the included template.
output: Training plan: begin with the included template and replace the environment name.
Validation: run a short CPU test before increasing environments or workers.
Tuning: measure steps per second, then adjust one parameter at a time.

output_examples.input: Design a cooperative multi-agent navigation environment.
output: Environment plan: define one observation and action contract per agent.
Reward plan: combine individual progress with a shared completion objective.
Validation plan: test agent keys, output types, global termination, and vectorized resets.

output_examples.input: Add Neptune logging and checkpointing to a training workflow.
output: Checkpoint plan: write periodic and final models to a user-approved directory.
Credential plan: obtain the Neptune token outside command-line arguments and exclude it from logged configuration.
Logging plan: send only approved metrics and non-secret hyperparameters.

best_practices: Run environment validation and a short training smoke test before scaling workers or GPUs.
Measure throughput after each vectorization change and retain comparable seeds and batch settings.
Keep logger credentials outside command-line arguments and allowlist configuration fields sent to external services.
anti_patterns: Do not trust throughput claims without benchmarking the actual environment, policy, and hardware.
Do not increase environment and worker counts without monitoring memory, utilization, and rollout latency.
Do not send tokens, private paths, or sensitive metadata to experiment logging services.

faq.question: What does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers PufferLib training, environments, policies, vectorization, integrations, checkpointing, and experiment logging.

faq.question: Can it help create a custom environment?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides single-agent and multi-agent templates plus guidance for spaces, rewards, termination, and validation.

faq.question: Does it support multi-agent reinforcement learning?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents multi-agent environments, shared or independent policies, PettingZoo integration, and vectorization.

faq.question: Does the skill install PufferLib automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents installation, but dependency installation remains an explicit user action.

faq.question: Are external logging services required?
faq.answer: No. Weights & Biases and Neptune are optional, and the templates also support training without an external logger.

faq.question: Are the stated throughput rates guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Throughput depends on environment complexity, policy architecture, batch configuration, hardware, and installed software versions.
